title: finding(pm): `dispatch-gates` never derives `check:verify-stand-in` for a change to `packages/verify/src` exports, so a new `@objectstack/verify` export passes every local gate and reds CI (PR #22907)
body:
Filing gate **①**: a defect with a named landing point and a measured cost. **Class (a):** the instrument a dev's local sweep is built from reads green where CI reds. `reach:` named real producer: PR #22907 (#15953 slice 1), whose CI went red on this gate after a local sweep that never ran it.

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `os-steve` · session `session_01VoSxBQujKLZKPwK2u5ehQ6`, from #15953's dev (`os-dev-report` `6115950326`, out-of-scope finding 1). The contract review on PR #22907 (`6116059950`) also escalated it as owed. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** triage grades it. The gate is `scripts/check-verify-stand-in-erasure.mjs`, with its population record in `scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs`. Both are `scripts/` gate tooling, so `domain:spec` under the anchoring rule unless triage routes it elsewhere.

## What is measured

On `origin/main` `7de0265fc7`:
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack packages/verify/src/reference-shape.ts packages/verify/src/index.ts` prints **0** lines matching `verify-stand-in`.
- CONTROL: the same command with `scripts/check-verify-stand-in-erasure.mjs` prints `pnpm check:verify-stand-in`, so the deriver knows the family but has no watch reaching the exports it judges.
- PR #22907 at `777263207d`: CI `Lint & Repo Gates` step 14 (`@objectstack/verify stand-in erasure guard`) exited 1 with `CLASSIFIED: packages/verify exports runReferenceShapeProofs(x: VerifyStack) … formatReferenceShapeReport(x: ReferenceShapeReport)`. The dev's derived local sweep (65 families) never included it, so the red cost one CI cycle and a patch round.

## Why

- The script's header (about `:72`) records `dispatch-gates: wide-population` as REFUSE-WIDE in `scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs` "on both halves". It refuses to declare `packages` and `examples` because the call-site census walks them, and declaring only the smaller root "would read as a claim about where the stand-ins land".
- The leg that redded is a different population. The `CLASSIFIED` / `DISCOVERED` / `RECONCILED` checks read only `packages/verify/src`'s exports (`:116`, `:139`, `:292`–`:337`). That population is exact and small, and a new export there is exactly what reds it.
- Seam: `scripts/check-verify-stand-in-erasure.mjs` population declaration → `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` watch-hint extraction.

## Related, same instrument (noted, not a separate card)

`@objectstack/core`'s `repo` test project holds whole-tree pins, such as `second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts`, which reds on any new reference-target arbiter caller under `packages/`. The derivation names `check:*` families, not another package's test project, so a dev learns of those from CI as well. PR #22907 redded on it too.

## Not measured

Whether other gates that refuse a wide population also carry a narrow leg the derivation could watch.

## Direction (not a ruling)

- Declare the classification leg's own population (`packages/verify/src`) as a watch, separately from the call-site census that stays REFUSE-WIDE. A change to that package's exports then derives `pnpm check:verify-stand-in`.
- Pin: the derive command above names the gate. CONTROL: a change outside `packages/verify` does not.

## Family and dedupe

The `dispatch-gates` derivation-gap family, all closed: #22680 (`check:liveness`), #22320 (`check:error-status-conformance`, a bare `SCAN_ROOT`), #21697 (symbol-anchor sweeps), #21011 (`check:i18n-coverage`), #20278 (diff-scope issue citations), #16447 (watch hints opening with a glob).

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included:
- `dispatch-gates derivation misses gate verify-stand-in packages/verify watch hint not derived`: 130 hits, none on this gate. The 10 read are the closed family above.
- `dispatch-gates does not name repo-project whole-tree pin test outside the touched package, learned from CI`: 189 hits, none open on this subject.
- CONTROL: both queries return the closed `dispatch-gates` family, so the instrument reaches it.

Dedupe words: dispatch-gates watch hint verify-stand-in; derivation misses check:verify-stand-in; packages/verify exports stand-in gate not derived; REFUSE-WIDE narrow leg.
